observations.blue_notes: Primary brand blue is vivid and saturated (used for CTAs and active states).
observations.accent_notes: Warm coral (#FA8269) used as a secondary accent for variety and to highlight items.
observations.contrast: Black on white and white on blue have strong contrast; watch contrast with midGrays for body text.

heading.note: explicitly present in second screenshot (labelled 'Heading 72 PX')

subheading.note: explicitly present in second screenshot (labelled 'Sub-heading 32 PX')

body.note: explicitly present in second screenshot (labelled 'Body 24 PX')

nav.note: estimated (used for primary nav items and small labels)

small.note: used for micro labels inside circular chips

container_gutters.note: gutters are estimated — layout uses generous white space and large vertical rhythm

grid.type: invisible modular 8px baseline with wide columns

rounded_strip_card.description: Large rounded rectangle across the width containing circular color swatches

border.note: no distinct outer stroke on colored circles; they sit on the rounded strip

inner_micro-pill.description: small rounded capsule inside each circle that contains the hex label
inner_micro-pill.background: semi-contrasting (white on dark circles, light translucent on bright circles)

hero_nav_pill.description: Rounded nav area in the hero (top bar) with a big pill search/CTA container

shadow.note: soft large shadow for elevated nav pill

inner_stroke_in_swatches.description: Each color circle contains a small inner capsule with the hex code. The capsule uses an inverted stroke or fill to remain legible (white capsule on dark circle; subtle dark stroke/capsule on light circles).

grid_background.description: Hero background contains a very light square grid (thin 1px lines) combined with a subtle top-to-bottom linear gradient.

gradient.note: very subtle — mostly to add texture behind large hero text

shadows_and_depth.usage: Shadows are soft, blurred, and used to float important UI elements (nav pill, cards, CTAs).

contrast.midGray_on_lightGray: may fail - keep body text at >=16px and semi-bold to be accessible
contrast.capsule_text_small: hex labels are small (12px) — ensure sufficient contrast or increase to 13-14px on production

accessibility_notes.tap_targets: Ensure interactive pills and buttons have at least 44x44 px clickable area on mobile.
accessibility_notes.font_scaling: Because headings are large, test at different viewport sizes; subheading should remain readable at 20–28px on tablet.

css_variables_sample.--font-sans: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial

example_css_snippets.hero_title: font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 72px; line-height: 1.05; color: var(--color-black);
example_css_snippets.rounded_strip: background: var(--color-surface); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 32px; display:flex; gap:24px; align-items:center;
example_css_snippets.color_circle: width:100px; height:100px; border-radius:50%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
example_css_snippets.capsule: background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); padding:6px 18px; border-radius:9999px; font-size:12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.06) inset;
